outcome: infant sleep characteristics (difficulties, disturbed sleep, awakenings)
cohort: The study included 151 new mothers with infants aged 6-12 months.
finding: Co-sleeping was associated with more difficulties in infant and maternal sleep, a positive correlation with breastfeeding, but no direct correlation with maternal mental health.
cross-section timing: Data collected from July to November 2021 when infants were aged 6-12 months.
